name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in low-light or high-contrast shots where EXCAVA stumbles, giving a measurable boost in perceived quality without extra compute cost. The trade-off is extra setup time—you’ll need to align the depth maps with EXCAVA’s existing masks—but the gain in clarity justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial sharpening tool, not a temporal one. The real risk is wasting time on a dead-end fix while motion-refiner models like SD3.5-Ultra’s black box remain untested. Test InstantX’s upscaler on a motion-blurred clip first; if it doesn’t move the needle, pivot to validating motion-refiner access before any pipeline tweaks.
